$ tensor completions
exit: 0
--- stdout
tensor completions — Generate shell completion script

Usage: tensor completions <bash|fish|nushell|zsh>

Arguments:
  shell  Shell to generate completions for

Setup:
  bash     eval "$(tensor completions bash)"  # add to ~/.bashrc
  fish     tensor completions fish | source   # add to ~/.config/fish/config.fish
  nushell  see `tensor completions nushell`   # add to config.nu
  zsh      eval "$(tensor completions zsh)"   # add to ~/.zshrc

Zsh: initialize completion with `autoload -Uz compinit; compinit` before evaluating the zsh hook. If your shell already runs compinit, place the hook after it.
<end>

<end>
